headline: Data Platform Architect & Practice Builder | Servant-Leader | 40+ Professionals Coached to Senior Roles | Cloud-Native (Azure, AWS, GCP) | Agentic AI
summary:
I build cloud-native data platforms and the teams that own them.

Over 20+ years I've designed event-driven, configuration-driven platforms on Azure, AWS, and GCP — where canonical data models and DSL-based ingestion abstract source system complexity so downstream use cases can move fast without re-solving integration problems. Healthcare, financial services, supply chain, consumer markets.

But the platforms aren't what I'm most proud of. It's this: I've directly coached 40+ people into higher roles — junior engineers into client-facing technical consultants, mid-level engineers into senior architects, individual contributors into engagement leads. My philosophy is simple: show by doing, then teach them to fish. Coaching isn't something I do in addition to delivery — it's embedded in how I deliver. The measure of success is whether the client team can own and extend the platform independently after the engagement ends.

I've built and scaled consulting practices from zero three times — $4.5M at SPR, $3M at NVISIA, $2M at PSC — tripling headcount while maintaining profitability. My approach to cross-functional leadership: create shared vocabulary, find the stakeholder who understands the strategic value, and demonstrate outcomes rather than assert authority. Unified architecture is non-negotiable.

Currently focused on agentic AI as a catalyst for automation in modern data platforms — building intelligent orchestration for data quality, ingestion, and operational workflows using local GPU inference, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent systems.

Core capabilities:
• Servant-leadership and practice building (zero to $4.5M+)
• Cloud-native data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
• Canonical data model design and operationalization
• Cross-functional stakeholder alignment
• Talent development and client enablement
• Agentic AI and intelligent data platform automation

current_job.title: Principal Technical Consultant
current_job.description:
Lead architect and cross-functional technical leader designing cloud-native, event-driven data platforms for healthcare and enterprise clients. Serve as servant-leader across engineering, architecture, product, and business leadership.

KEY CONTRIBUTIONS:
• Introduced canonical data model vocabulary (core data products, use-case data products, producers, consumers, consumables) as shared decomposition framework — unified cross-functional teams of engineers, architects, product owners, product managers, and data/business/IT leaders around common language
• Resolved conceptual friction by coaching data engineers to understand grain and relationships in their domains, transitioning team from ad-hoc to repeatable, consistent work products
• Operationalized platforms with client teams through embedded design-thinking and architectural trade-off coaching, enabling independent ownership and extension post-engagement
• Led stakeholder alignment across multiple organizational layers by demonstrating outcomes rather than asserting authority

previous_jobs.title: Director, Advisory, Data Architecture
previous_jobs.description:
Chief architect and servant-leader directing Data as a Product capability. Managed distributed global team of 50+ across onshore and offshore with $5M+ budget — without direct line authority over many team members.

KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS:
• Coached consulting firm architects through strategic leap from 'build for one client' to 'scalable firm asset' — unified platform architecture translated directly into marketing and sales materials for go-to-market
• Developed junior offshore engineer from task implementer to client-facing design conversation leader through progressive coaching. Proof: client team launched new use case independently post-engagement
• Insisted on hyperscaler-agnostic architecture extending platform from Azure to AWS and GCP — got senior partner alignment, prevented fragmentation into three separate implementations
• Presented unified architecture case to partners — stakes were binary (unified vs. fragmented). Architecture remained unified, shaping how platform was built and marketed firm-wide
• Resolved executive misalignment on data quality expectations in real-time: stopped presentation, named the gap, achieved consensus with client enablement path
• Built structured coaching cadence: verbal debriefs, Teams feedback loops, pointed document comments demanding polished outputs

recommendations_received.author_job_title: Enterprise Data Strategy, Data Governance and Data Management, Consulting, Chief Data & Analytics Officer (CDAO)
recommendations_received.text: I worked closely with Mike during his time as Platform Solution Architect, supporting our enterprise Data Lakehouse Platform initiative. He played an important role in shaping the architecture that allowed us to standardize canonical data models and deliver trusted, governed data products across several healthcare domains. Mike combines strong architectural instincts with the ability to think strategically about how platforms enable real business outcomes. His work helped establish a scalable, configuration-driven foundation for data quality, governance, and analytics that continues to benefit the organization. I would gladly work with Mike again in any enterprise data transformation effort.

I've been working with Mike for more than three years and all this time he's been surprising me again and again with his kind, friendly and patient guidance in the most complicated projects. Many times he converted my rough straightforward ideas into something elegant, generic and reusable and then helped me to comprehend and implement it. Nothing helps professional growth more than the opportunity to work side-by-side with a real Architect and I'm glad I was given this chance.

Mike and I worked closely together and I have seen first hand how hard he works. He is a team player, willing to do what it takes to get the job done. Mike has a great presence with clients. He can articulate complex concepts to the most senior leaders or to the most junior engineers. He has the practical, hands-on background to understand the nuanced and sometimes subtle barriers to success. His dedication to results, along with a great sense of humor, makes him a pleasure to work with. I would welcome the opportunity to work with Mike again in the future.

Mike has very solid technical background and in depth industry domain knowledge. He is very easy to work with, can work independently also a great team player. His ability of effective communication with business partners/users, unselfishness result-oriented attitude and great cooperation contribute a lots of many my successful projects. I am very happy having him on my team.

Mike is one of most well-rounded technologists I have had the privilege of working with. His wealth and depth of technical, business, and industry knowledge is impressive. He is driven, result-oriented, and highly productive. I found him very easy to work with. He is also a great team player who possesses excellent communication skills. In short, Mike has been a great asset for the data management department at Newedge.

Not only is Mike a pioneer in the data management and analytics space, Mike's military background makes him approach technology in a very disciplined manner, which is vital for a management level technology worker. Mike's consulting meetings with my clients inevitably produced jaw-dropping reactions, as they had solutions to major business problems right at their finger-tips but needed his expertise and insight to find them.

I found Mike to be a highly competent developer and very easy to work with. He was able to handle any challenge both technical and non-technical that he was faced with. I would absolutely recommend Mike and am confident that he will exceed expectations.
